other.powersofarrest:
Arrest without warrant
If a person is found drunk in any highway or other public place, whether a building or not, or on any licensed premises, and appears to be incapable of taking care of himself, he may be arrested by anyone else (section 1 Licensing Act 1902).

Upon arrest for an offence under this section 12, the offender may in certain circumstances, be taken to a detoxification or alcohol treatment centre.
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale.

Penalty Notice for Disorder - Sixty pounds.

Note:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
